# How fast is Margince every day?

<!-- GENERATED by `make perfdoc` from the bench-daily record; do not edit by hand. -->

How long the screens a sales rep and a sales manager open every day take to answer,
measured on a test company the size of a mid-market customer. Each answer comes from
many tries, and the time shown is one that nearly every try beat.

| Colour | What it means |
|---|---|
| 🟢 Fast | Within the time we promise. |
| 🟡 Slower than we promise | Over the promise, and we are working on it: the issue is linked. |
| 🔴 Too slow | Over the promise with no fix under way yet, or some tries failed. |
| ⚪ Not measured | The screen had nothing to show yet, or the run cannot prove it. |

<details>
<summary>How this page is made</summary>

Generated by `make perfdoc` from the `bench-daily` record under `docs/reference/perfbench/`,
which `make bench-daily` writes; do not edit by hand.
The test company has 250,000 contacts at 10,000 companies, 25,000 deals, 100,000 leads,
500 projects and 500,000 activities, owned by 12 reps under 2 managers.

Measured on 2026-10-07 on Apple M1 Pro (8 cores, 16 GiB), Postgres 16.14.
Each time is the p95 of its rows: 95 in every 100 tries were faster.

Rounding: under 250 ms reads "under a quarter of a second", under 1 s "under a second",
then seconds to one decimal, and whole seconds from 10 s on. The colour is the bench's own verdict
against the budget, and a moment takes the worst of its rows.

Every number, per seat and against its budget id: [performance-budgets.md](performance-budgets.md).
How a case is chosen and added: [design-a-bench-case.md](../how-to/design-a-bench-case.md).

</details>

## How fast does my morning start?

| Moment | Rep | Manager | In plain words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Opening the app | 🟢 Under a quarter of a second | 🟢 Under a quarter of a second | Fast. |
| The Worklist | 🟡 About 17 seconds | 🟡 About 8.1 seconds | Slower than we promise: we are working on it ([#4912](https://github.com/margince/margince/issues/4912)). |
| Home | 🟡 About 16 seconds | 🟡 About 4.2 seconds | Slower than we promise: we are working on it ([#4912](https://github.com/margince/margince/issues/4912)). |

The first open after a restart is slower, because nothing is warmed up yet:

- The Worklist for a rep, first open after a restart: about 17 seconds.
- Search for a rep, first open after a restart: about 1.5 seconds.

## What happens when the whole team starts at 9:00?

Every rep and manager opens the app, the Worklist, Home and a few records at the same moment.

| Moment | Whole team | In plain words |
|---|---|---|
| A small request while everyone starts | 🟡 Under a second | Slower than we promise: we are working on it ([#7068](https://github.com/margince/margince/issues/7068)). |
